messages:
maria: Quick sync  PR #4321 adds the SDK auth_v2 examples (new `Authorization: Redw <token>` header flow) and a short migration guide. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321

alex: thanks. Note: auth_v2 is behind a feature flag `auth_v2_enable` rolling out starting 2026-04-03. If we merge to main now the preview site will show the new auth sample before users have the backend. Can we gate the doc?

tara: can we add a front-matter flag like `ff_gate: auth_v2_enable` so the site generator hides it until flag is live?

maria: yes, our tooling checks `ff_gate` and hides content from production search, but preview builds still render it for reviewers. That should be fine if we also mark `unreleased: true` in front-matter.

jin: alternative is to land to `release/v1.12` and only merge to main after the FF reaches 20%. Which approach do we prefer?

alex: preference: quick patch -> move the page into `versioned_docs/version-1.12/` and add a banner at top: "Note: requires auth_v2 feature flag. Not available until 2026-04-03." That keeps main clean. If ops confirms FF at >=20% within 24h of rollout we can merge the main version and remove the banner.

ci-bot: preview-site check  running build for PR #4321. Current status: 1 failed job (link-checker), 3 passed.

tara: link-checker fail is typically due to the internal api reference we added. I can update the link to the stable path.

ci-bot: rerun requested by tara. Build queued.

ops-bot: FF status (auth_v2_enable)  global rollout started 2026-04-03 04:15 UTC. Current backfill: 5% (us-east), 3% (eu-west). Target 72h backfill window.

maria: merge cutoff reminder  docs freeze ends 2026-04-02 00:00 UTC; post-freeze merges are allowed but we should avoid exposing gated features early. If FF <20% by 2026-04-03 12:00 UTC, prefer release branch landing.

ci-bot: preview-site build complete for PR #4321  4/4 jobs passed. Link: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4321

tara: updated the link, added front-matter: `ff_gate: auth_v2_enable`, `unreleased: true`, and a banner paragraph. Also moved the file to `versioned_docs/version-1.12/auth-migration.md` per alex's suggestion.

jin: I'll review the SDK snippet and add a tiny example showing both header styles: old `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and new `Authorization: Redw <token>`. Will leave one minor phrasing nit.

alex: assigned reviewers: @jin (SDK snippet), @maria (migration wording), @tara (link fixes). If reviewers approve and ops reports >=20% by 2026-04-03 12:00 UTC I'll open a follow-up PR to land the main copy and remove `unreleased`. Otherwise we'll merge to `release/v1.12` after cutover.

maria: I've drafted release notes entry at https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/pull/101 noting that docs are gated until FF backfill.

ops-bot: FF status update (auth_v2_enable)  2026-04-03 11:30 UTC  global 22% (canary regions stable).

alex: ops hit 22%  good signal. I'll prepare PR to promote versioned page back to main and remove the banner. Expect that follow-up PR in ~30m.

tara: LGTM from me on the moved page.

jin: approved after adding the dual-header example.

ci-bot: follow-up preview build for promote PR #4330  4/4 jobs passed. Link: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4330

alex: promoted and merged to main at 2026-04-03 13:05 UTC. Release notes updated. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
